_doc: Phase 3d run game (play/sim.ts). toss: the QB pitches pitchAt s after the snap, the pitch takes pitchTime s; the back's path catches it depth yd behind the LOS at 55 % of the aim, turns the corner cornerDepth yd behind the LOS at the aim, then goes upfield. backfield: a carrier behind the LOS who is running mostly sideways (lateral share of his speed >= minLateral) cannot lower his shoulder: tackles on him get x lateralTackle. edge (toss only): the contain man is the box defender or rusher lined up furthest to the play side within maxDepth yd of the LOS. He reads the toss after `read` s (no run key needed: anything wide is his) and attacks the corner point aimBehind yd behind it until the back is past the LOS; blocked, he plays the reach block (blocking.json reach) and goes back to the corner once free. Variance: his read is read x lognormal(readSigma), with chance late x (1.2 - awareness / 100) he is fooled and reads lateDelay s later, and his aim point is off by a normal(aimSigma) yd (block RNG stream). openField (toss): past the corner the auto-run back bends away from unblocked defenders within lookAhead yd ahead of him (weight avoid), keeping sidelineMargin yd off the sideline.
